papers.title: Advancement or Acceleration? How Data Curation Improves LLM Training
papers.description: Formalizes the distinction between advancement (improving attainable performance) vs acceleration (reaching same performance faster) in data curation. Shows advancement requires a correctable train-target gap. Proposes the Delta-test as an observable predictor of curation gains.

papers.title: AQL-Lite: Enabling Efficient Knowledge Acquisition for Arabic LLMs via Data-Centric Continual Pretraining
papers.description: Quality-first curation pipeline (structural cleaning, heuristic + model-based filtering, MSA selection, deduplication) coupled with partial-parameter CPT recipe. Recovers 94% of full-parameter CPT gain in 52% wall-clock time. Scaled to 40B MSA tokens.

papers.title: UniGeM: Unifying Data Selection and Mixing via Geometric Exploration and Mining
papers.description: Framework that unifies data mixing and selection by treating data curation as geometric exploration. Combines instance-level and domain-level approaches using geometric representations.

papers.title: TiKMiX: Efficient Semi-Dynamic Data Mixture via Data Influence for LLM Pre-training
papers.description: Semi-dynamic data mixing framework grounded in influence ranking invariance observation. Bridges gap between static (suboptimal) and fully dynamic (computationally expensive) mixing strategies.

papers.title: DaMo: Data Mixing Optimizer in Fine-tuning Multimodal LLMs for Mobile Phone Agents
papers.description: Data mixing optimizer for multimodal LLM fine-tuning targeting mobile phone agents. Addresses optimal training data composition for multitask SFT.

papers.title: Optimizing Training Data Diversity with DataSpinner: An LLM-driven Curator-Agent Approach
papers.description: LLM-driven curator agent that treats dataset diversity optimization as a sequential decision problem. Mitigates distributional collapse where training corpus converges toward narrow low-diversity subsets.

papers.title: Scalable Entity-Centric Data Filtration for LLM Pretraining
papers.description: Entity-centric filtering framework using entities as compact semantic anchors to identify and remove redundant or low-density information from pretraining corpora.

papers.title: Repetition over Diversity: High-Signal Data Filtering for Sample-Efficient German Language Modeling
papers.description: Investigates quality vs diversity trade-off for German LLM data filtering: should practitioners prioritize diversity (large lightly-filtered data) or quality (strictly filtered core repeated over epochs)? Constructs hierarchical filtering pipeline for Boldt model family.

papers.title: DADFS: A Dynamic Adaptive Data Filtering and Sampling Framework for Optimized Fine-Tuning of Large Language Models
papers.description: Framework combining Dynamic Adaptive Filtering, Adaptive Data Sampling, and Data Mixing with Proportional Weighting for LLM fine-tuning. Integrates LoRA within PEFT framework.

tools_and_repos.name: Marin
tools_and_repos.description: Open-source framework for research covering full LLM data pipeline: data curation, transformation, filtering, tokenization, pretraining, posttraining, and evaluation. Committed to open development and sharing process knowledge.

tools_and_repos.name: LLM-Sanitizer-Pro
tools_and_repos.description: Clean, de-identify and curate LLM training data at scale: PII & secrets redaction, quality filtering. Python-based tool for scalable data sanitization.
